brief.role: A freelance illustrator who just created a Tidemark account from a friend's referral link and is looking at their empty workspace for the first time
brief.job: Understand what this tool will do for them, get a first client added within a minute, and trust that exploring will not break anything.
brief.time_budget: one minute to first client added
brief.consequence: First-run abandonment is permanent for most trials; a user who cannot see the value path in the first session does not come back for a second one.
facts: Tidemark tracks client work for freelancers: each client holds projects, and each project holds tasks and invoices. This workspace was created moments ago and holds no clients, no projects, no invoices.
The navigation sections that exist are exactly: Clients, Projects, Invoices, Reports, Settings. Invoices and Reports are functional but have nothing to show until data exists.
The one primary path: add a first client — name required, email optional — after which Tidemark offers to create that client's first project.
An "Explore with sample data" option exists: it fills the workspace with one clearly labelled sample client and its projects, removable with one click at any time.
The account is on a 14-day free trial that started today and includes everything. After it, the free plan keeps 1 client and makes invoices read-only. Upgrading costs $12/month.
There is no team or invite capability at this plan level. Nothing else about the product may be assumed.

required_interactions: Add the first client and reach the first-project offer
Enter sample-data mode, look around, and remove the sample data
Visit Invoices and Reports while they are empty
acceptance_checks: The empty workspace teaches the object model — clients hold projects, projects hold tasks and invoices — at the moment it matters, not as a tour.
Every empty section states what will appear there and the shortest path to making that happen; there are no dead ends.
Trial status is visible but proportionate; the supplied trial and plan facts render exactly, with no invented upgrade pressure.
Sample data is unmistakably distinguishable from real data everywhere it appears, and leaving sample mode is as easy as entering it.
